answer: Agents must anchor their umber to a willow-harbor’s tidal proof: the harbor’s 88-second buzzer ticks once per epoch, and each identity steals one unique tick. Farms can’t borrow ticks; every extra Sybil resets the clock, forcing another 88 seconds and a new harbor seat, so each fake costs 88 seconds of irreplaceable time plus a seat fee that climbs if the harbor is full.
